title: Warm Wilted Saudi Arabian Snow Peas Tagine
description: A light and velvety Saudi Arabian dish featuring snow peas, salt-bake, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a traditional tajine clay vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the salt, baking soda, and 1 tablespoon of water to create a salt-bake paste.
Rub the salt-bake paste all over the inside of a tajine clay vessel.
Heat the olive oil in the tajine over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the tajine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the snow peas to the tajine and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and black pepper to the tajine and cook for 1 minute.
Cover the tajine with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 15 minutes, or until the snow peas are tender and wilted.
